local PER = 6 local TOTAL = 32 local CONNS = { true, false, false, false, false } local offset = 0
local function captions() for i = 1, PER do local col = offset * PER + i local lbl = self.children['col_lbl_' .. i] if lbl then if col <= TOTAL then lbl.values.text = string.format('COL %d', col) else lbl.values.text = '-' end end end end
local handlers = {}
handlers.hit = function(i) local col = offset * PER + i if col <= TOTAL then sendOSC(string.format('/composition/columns/%d/connect', col), 1, CONNS) end end
handlers.shift = function(dir) local pages = math.ceil(TOTAL / PER) offset = offset + dir if offset < 0 then offset = pages - 1 elseif offset > pages - 1 then offset = 0 end captions() end
function init() captions() end
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) local h = handlers[key] if h then h(val) end end

local MULT = { 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 } local MIN, MAX = 0.00, 10.00 local CONNS = { true, false, false, false, false } local PATH = '/composition/speed'
local function stop() return MULT[math.floor(self.values.x * (#MULT - 1) + 0.5) + 1] end
local function caption(m) local lbl = self.parent.children.speed_label if lbl then lbl.values.text = string.format('SPEED %gx', m) end end
function init() -- Label only: pushing a speed at load would stamp on whatever Resolume -- already has. caption(stop()) end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then local m = stop() caption(m) sendOSC(PATH, (m - MIN) / (MAX - MIN), CONNS) end end

local base = self.name:gsub('_swatch$', '') local sib = self.parent.children local chip = sib[base .. '_chip']
-- Opens on RELEASE, not press. The picker's overlay hides itself on any -- touch, so opening it under a finger that is still down closes it again on -- the spot -- which looks like the dialog flickering. function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' and self.values.x == 0 then root.children.ColorPicker:notify('pickColor', { callback = self, initial = chip.color }) end end
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) if key == 'colorPicked' then chip.color = val sib[base .. '_r'].values.x = val.r sib[base .. '_g'].values.x = val.g sib[base .. '_b'].values.x = val.b end end

local MIN, MAX = 20.00, 500.00 local f = self.parent.children.bpm_value
local function bpm() return MIN + f.values.x * (MAX - MIN) end
local function setBpm(v) if v < MIN then v = MIN elseif v > MAX then v = MAX end f.values.x = (v - MIN) / (MAX - MIN) end
function onValueChanged(key) -- On release: the keyboard's overlay would swallow a touch still held. if key == 'x' and self.values.x == 0 then root.children.NumPad:notify('showNumPad', { callback = self, initial = string.format('%.1f', bpm()) }) end end
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) if key == 'numberEntered' then setBpm(val) end end

local base = self.name:gsub('_swatch$', '') local sib = self.parent.children local chip = sib[base .. '_chip']
-- Opens on RELEASE, not press. The picker's overlay hides itself on any -- touch, so opening it under a finger that is still down closes it again on -- the spot -- which looks like the dialog flickering. function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' and self.values.x == 0 then root.children.ColorPicker:notify('pickColor', { callback = self, initial = chip.color }) end end
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) if key == 'colorPicked' then chip.color = val sib[base .. '_r'].values.x = val.r sib[base .. '_g'].values.x = val.g sib[base .. '_b'].values.x = val.b end end

local caller = nil local receiver = nil local preview = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Preview local red = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Red local green = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Green local blue = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Blue local alpha = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Alpha
function setCol(from) red.values.x = from.r green.values.x = from.g blue.values.x = from.b alpha.values.x = from.a
end
function setSwatch(col) local swatchContainer = self.children.ColorDialog.children.Swatches local swatches = swatchContainer.children local idx = tonumber(swatchContainer.tag) or 0 local colStr = Color.toHexString(col)
for i = 1,idx do -- ignore if already in swatches if Color.toHexString(swatches[i].color) == colStr then return end end
if idx < #swatches then idx = idx + 1 else idx = #swatches for i = 1,#swatches-1 do swatches[i].color = swatches[i+1].color end end swatches[idx].color = col swatches[idx].tag = 'set' swatchContainer.tag = idx end
local notifyHandler = { pickColor = function(val) caller = val.callback receiver = val.receiver if val.initial then setCol(val.initial) else if receiver then setCol(receiver.color) end end
self.visible = true end,
ok = function() self.visible = false local newColor = Color(preview.color.r, preview.color.g, preview.color.b, preview.color.a)
setSwatch(newColor)
if receiver then receiver.color = newColor end
if caller then caller:notify("colorPicked", newColor) end end,
cancel = function() self.visible = false if caller then caller:notify('colorPickCancel') end end }
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) local handler = notifyHandler[key] if handler then handler(val) end end
function onValueChanged(key) notifyHandler.cancel() end

local hex = self.parent.children.Hex local preview = self.parent.children.Preview local hLbl = self.parent.children.ghLbl
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then local hexColor = Color.toHexString(preview.color) hLbl.values.text = string.sub(hexColor,3,4) hex.values.text = hexColor end end

local hex = self.parent.children.Hex local preview = self.parent.children.Preview local hLbl = self.parent.children.bhLbl
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then local hexColor = Color.toHexString(preview.color) hLbl.values.text = string.sub(hexColor,5,6) hex.values.text = hexColor end end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then if self.values.x == 1 then self.outline = true else self.outline = false self.parent.parent:notify('cancel') end end end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then if self.values.x == 1 then self.outline = true else self.outline = false self.parent.parent:notify('ok') end end end

local hex = self.parent.children.Hex local preview = self.parent.children.Preview local hLbl = self.parent.children.ahLbl
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then local hexColor = Color.toHexString(preview.color) hLbl.values.text = string.sub(hexColor,7,8) hex.values.text = hexColor end end

local hex = self.parent.children.Hex local preview = self.parent.children.Preview local hLbl = self.parent.children.rhLbl
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then local hexColor = Color.toHexString(preview.color) hLbl.values.text = string.sub(hexColor,1,2) hex.values.text = hexColor end end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' then if self.values.x == 1 then self.parent.children.Grayscale.visible = true else self.parent.children.Grayscale.visible = false end end end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'touch' and not self.values.touch then local btn = self.parent.children.BWOption btn.values.x = btn.values.x == 1 and 0 or 1 end end

local rCtrl = self.parent.children.Red.values local gCtrl = self.parent.children.Green.values local bCtrl = self.parent.children.Blue.values local aCtrl = self.parent.children.Alpha.values function shade(v,s) v = v + (s-.5) * 2 if v < 0 then v = 0 else if v > 1 then v = 1 end end return v end
function doColor(x,y) if x <= 1/6 then rCtrl.x = shade(1,y) gCtrl.x = shade(6*x, y) bCtrl.x = shade(0,y) else if x <= 1/3 then gCtrl.x = shade(1,y) bCtrl.x = shade(0,y) rCtrl.x = shade(1-(6* (x-1/6)),y) else if x <= 1/2 then rCtrl.x = shade(0,y) gCtrl.x = shade(1,y) bCtrl.x = shade(6*(x-1/3),y) else if x <= 2/3 then rCtrl.x = shade(0,y) bCtrl.x = shade(1,y) gCtrl.x = shade(1 - 6*(x-0.5),y) else if x <= 5/6 then gCtrl.x = shade(0,y) bCtrl.x = shade(1,y) rCtrl.x = shade(6*(x-2/3),y) else -- x <= 1 gCtrl.x = shade(0,y) rCtrl.x = shade(1,y) bCtrl.x = shade(1 - 6*(x-5/6),y) end end end end end end
function doBW(x) gCtrl.x = x rCtrl.x = x bCtrl.x = x end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' or key == 'y' then if self.parent.children.BWOption.values.x == 1 then doBW(self.values.x) else doColor(self.values.x, self.values.y) end end end

local caller = nil local entry = '' local display = self.children.dialog.children.display
local function refresh() display.values.text = (entry == '' and '0' or entry) end
local handlers = {}
handlers.showNumPad = function(val) caller = val and val.callback or nil entry = (val and val.initial) and tostring(val.initial) or '' refresh() self.visible = true end
handlers.key = function(ch) if ch == 'del' then entry = string.sub(entry, 1, -2) elseif ch == '.' then if not string.find(entry, '%.') then entry = entry .. '.' end elseif string.len(entry) < 6 then entry = entry .. ch end refresh() end
handlers.ok = function() local n = tonumber(entry) self.visible = false if caller and n then caller:notify('numberEntered', n) end end
handlers.cancel = function() self.visible = false if caller then caller:notify('numPadCanceled') end end
function onReceiveNotify(key, val) local h = handlers[key] if h then h(val) end end
function onValueChanged(key) if key == 'x' and self.values.x == 0 then self.parent:notify('cancel') end end
